counterhypotheses.title: Why did the valuation comparator change?
counterhypotheses.description: Methodology change is disclosed; motivation and substantive fairness cannot be established from the press releases alone. Alternatives: Ordinary revaluation after failed competition and market-price distortion: Consistent independent methodologies, contemporaneous instructions and comparable-bank inputs support the revised comparator. Improper tailoring of the benchmark to a preferred bid: Contemporaneous authorized records would need to show selective changes, conflicts, unequal treatment or departures from the published process. Apparent inconsistency caused by different dates, price concepts or missing records: Reconcile reserve, fair-value benchmark, valuation dates, capital structure and bid conditions.
